prerequisites: fix/precleanse-gap-card merged into dev; branch intermediate-routine from origin/dev afterwards (shared files carry that branch's uncommitted work)

decisions_from_product_owner.no_release_no_users: No migration or back-compat; default routine style is Balanced for everyone (one constant).
decisions_from_product_owner.not_silent: Steps the style calls for (toner, eye cream) raise gap cards when the shelf cannot fill them; shelf products not in the routine are listed with a reason on the Routines screen.
decisions_from_product_owner.filter_vs_selection: Technical decision, recorded as an assumption: the style changes slot selection before admission.

unblocked_scope.summary: All of FE-1..FE-11 and DOC-1 in the tech design. Phase A (style, toner, eye cream, gap cards), Phase B (enzyme exfoliant) and Phase C (left-out list, style control) can be built in that order; each phase is independently shippable.

needs_clarification_non_blocking.Q1: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION -> owner: product owner. Selectable third 'Complete' style now? Default: no.
needs_clarification_non_blocking.Q2: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION -> owner: product owner. Gap card for a missing enzyme exfoliant? Default: no (exfoliation is skin-state dependent).
needs_clarification_non_blocking.Q3: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION -> owner: clinical consultant. Review of draft values: enzyme matchers, 3 days a week, 12-ingredient window, barrier-repair deferral, AM preference.
needs_clarification_non_blocking.Q4: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION -> owner: design. Style names and PLACEHOLDER copy in spec section 5.

key_findings_from_planning: The reserve bucket is rendered in the Draft Preview (collapsed, with per-row 'Add anyway') but never on the saved Routines screen.
Live gap cards come from validateCurrentRoutines().proposedPlan.placeholders (a fresh hypothetical plan), so Balanced gap cards need no UI and an engine change reaches the live screen without a save.
Essential equals today's engine over 600 seeded shelves except one relabelled reserve reason (outside_routine_depth).
Unguarded, 'Add anyway' on an enzyme product schedules it AM and PM every day; the override block must re-enter the preferred period only and apply the cap.

Latent test gap at today's engine: scheduled-and-frozen disjointness is asserted per product but is legal per period (seeds 157 and 362 of a 1000-seed sweep); assert per hard gate before widening seeds or parametrizing.
notes_for_qa_lead: Reference shelves R9, S3, E4 and their expected results are in spec section 4.
Parametrize the explainability, determinism-and-safety and generate suites over both styles; pin depth essential in the tier-contract tests.
spec_status_at_qa: DRAFT (unchanged) - tests written against a DRAFT spec; product owner confirmed the test plan, not the spec itself
